notes.title: Hot Therapy: Trading Cards & Performance Update
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a new update for Hot Therapy! First, we’ve added the highly requested trading card feature. Now, as you play, you can collect unique trading cards that showcase artwork and iconic moments from the game. These cards are perfect for collectors and longtime fans alike, adding another layer of enjoyment and replay value.

We’ve also tackled the issues surrounding blurry visuals. Many of you reported that some scenes appeared fuzzy or unclear, so we refined our rendering system to provide a sharp, high-quality experience. You’ll notice more crisp details and smoother visuals as you progress through the game.

In addition to these enhancements, we focused on performance improvements and bug fixes. Various optimizations behind the scenes help the game run more efficiently, and we’ve squashed a number of annoying bugs to ensure a smoother gaming experience.

We hope you enjoy this latest update, and we’d love to hear your feedback as we continue to improve Hot Therapy. Thank you for your support and happy gaming!
